experiment.stage: user-approved observed surface conditions, not future geodesic supervision
experiment.surface_domain: frame0 visible target mask only; pixel-grid graph path approximation, not full object geodesic
experiment.pixel_adjacency: 8-neighbor; diagonal requires both supporting pixels inside mask
experiment.unreachable_policy: retain all queries; fill missing neighbor slots from unique image neighbors; distance=0 plus missing flag
experiment.distance_normalization: RMS radius of the corresponding 48 surface query positions
experiment.interpretation: exploratory new condition test; no tuning on G2 test results
experiment.oracle_GT_used_as_input: oracle_visible_surface only; never a RGB-only method result
